# Jeff Lazarus, MD - Medical Hypnotherapy

> A medical hypnotherapy practice specializing in evidence-based treatment for anxiety disorders, performance anxiety, pediatric conditions, and gastrointestinal disorders using hypnosis and cognitive behavioral therapy.

Dr. Jeff Lazarus, MD, FAAP is a pediatrician and board-certified medical hypnotherapist offering both in-person and telemedicine consultations. The practice combines medical hypnosis with CBT to treat a wide range of conditions from anxiety and phobias to IBS and pediatric bedwetting.
